summary: FirstSun Capital Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting that its bank subsidiary closed the sale of ~$890M of performing multifamily CRE loans (acquired from First Foundation) to entities affiliated with Brookfield Asset Management. No per-share price or premium given; sale was part of the earlier First Foundation acquisition closing on April 1, 2026. Proceeds will pay down high-cost brokered deposits. Board recommendation is not stated; no advisors named. The transaction is a portfolio sale, not a corporate divestiture of a business line. Watch for completion of remaining loan downsizing and balance sheet repositioning by Q2 2026.
